Six signals add up to a capped score

Category set and thresholds are project rules; tune and validate them before real use.

A clear prototype — not a production strategy
Sentinel demonstrates transparent rule-based screening, with important limits to resolve before any real deployment.

• Explainable weighted rules
• Searchable transaction review
• API for screening a new transaction

• Demo records and labels are synthetic
• No measured detection performance
• No model, compliance, or security validation
Validate on representative, governed data  →  measure false positives and misses  →  review privacy, security, and compliance.
